title: MiniStore and useStore
scenario: Build the shared state layer behind a React workspace for saved snippets, bookmarks, and notes. Independent panels need consistent updates, narrow subscriptions, and clean unmount behavior.

milestones.title: Store state and listener contracts
milestones.goal: Create a readable store with isolated instances and releasable subscriptions.

examples.input: Subscribe a listener, update bookmarks to 5, unsubscribe, then update bookmarks to 6
examples.call: (() => { const store = createMiniStore({ bookmarks: 2 }); let hits = 0; const stop = store.subscribe(() => { hits += 1; }); store.setState({ bookmarks: 5 }); stop(); store.setState({ bookmarks: 6 }); return { finalState: store.getState(), hits }; })()

milestones.title: Immutable updates and selectors
milestones.goal: Apply partial and updater-based changes without mutating caller-owned values or discarding unrelated fields.

examples.input: store = createMiniStore({ count: 3, theme: 'light' }); store.setState({ count: 7 }); store.getState()
examples.explanation: Unchanged fields remain preserved across partial updates.
examples.call: (() => { const store = createMiniStore({ count: 3, theme: 'light' }); store.setState({ count: 7 }); return store.getState(); })()

examples.input: store = createMiniStore({ count: 3, theme: 'light' }); store.setState((prev) => ({ count: prev.count + 2 })); store.getState()
examples.call: (() => { const store = createMiniStore({ count: 3, theme: 'light' }); store.setState((prev) => ({ count: prev.count + 2 })); return store.getState(); })()

milestones.title: React subscription hook
milestones.goal: Expose a typed selected snapshot to React and keep it synchronized with store changes.

examples.input: Render component reading useStore(store, (s) => s.openCount) with initial state { openCount: 4 }
examples.call: (async () => { const React = (await import('react')).default; const { render, screen, cleanup } = await import('@testing-library/react'); const store = createMiniStore({ openCount: 4 }); const Panel = () => React.createElement('output', { 'aria-label': 'Open count' }, String(useStore(store, (s) => s.openCount))); render(React.createElement(Panel)); const out = screen.getByLabelText('Open count').textContent; cleanup(); return out; })()

examples.input: Render component reading openCount = 1, then call store.setState({ openCount: 6 })
examples.call: (async () => { const React = (await import('react')).default; const { render, screen, act, cleanup } = await import('@testing-library/react'); const store = createMiniStore({ openCount: 1 }); const Panel = () => React.createElement('output', { 'aria-label': 'Open count' }, String(useStore(store, (s) => s.openCount))); render(React.createElement(Panel)); const before = screen.getByLabelText('Open count').textContent; act(() => { store.setState({ openCount: 6 }); }); const after = screen.getByLabelText('Open count').textContent; cleanup(); return { before, after }; })()

milestones.title: Render boundary verification
milestones.goal: Ensure views selecting unchanged values do not render again when unrelated state changes.

examples.input: Render TabView (selecting s.tab) and UnreadView (selecting s.unread), then update unread from 2 to 5
examples.explanation: Updating an unrelated slice does not re-render views whose selected value did not change.
examples.call: (async () => { const React = (await import('react')).default; const { render, screen, act, cleanup } = await import('@testing-library/react'); const store = createMiniStore({ tab: 'notes', unread: 2 }); let tabRenders = 0; const TabView = () => { tabRenders += 1; return React.createElement('output', { 'aria-label': 'Tab' }, useStore(store, (s) => s.tab)); }; const UnreadView = () => React.createElement('output', { 'aria-label': 'Unread' }, String(useStore(store, (s) => s.unread))); render(React.createElement(React.Fragment, null, React.createElement(TabView), React.createElement(UnreadView))); act(() => { store.setState({ unread: 5 }); }); const res = { tab: screen.getByLabelText('Tab').textContent, unread: screen.getByLabelText('Unread').textContent, tabRenders }; cleanup(); return res; })()

examples.input: Render PanelView (selecting s.panel) and ZoomView (selecting s.zoom), then update zoom from 100 to 125
examples.call: (async () => { const React = (await import('react')).default; const { render, screen, act, cleanup } = await import('@testing-library/react'); const store = createMiniStore({ panel: 'editor', zoom: 100 }); let panelRenders = 0; const PanelView = () => { panelRenders += 1; return React.createElement('output', { 'aria-label': 'Panel' }, useStore(store, (s) => s.panel)); }; const ZoomView = () => React.createElement('output', { 'aria-label': 'Zoom' }, String(useStore(store, (s) => s.zoom))); render(React.createElement(React.Fragment, null, React.createElement(PanelView), React.createElement(ZoomView))); act(() => { store.setState({ zoom: 125 }); }); const res = { panel: screen.getByLabelText('Panel').textContent, zoom: screen.getByLabelText('Zoom').textContent, panelRenders }; cleanup(); return res; })()
